data.content:
Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [Order the swatch!](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a68c8d8653603721b5d9661)
The color was not very accurate to the website photographs and I realize I should have ordered the swatch but, I incorrectly thought it would be closer to the images and less orange than how it reads in real life. Also, the furniture smell/fumes were so strong that the varnish smell was burning our eyes and we had to move it outside for 24hrs to get rid of the smell. I would be much more careful about what I order in the future to ensure color matches.

July 15, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Jul 29, 2026

Hi Phillipa,

Thank you for your feedback! We offer wood swatches for select furniture items that can be purchased before finalizing your order. Some furniture pieces may have a natural odor that tends to air out, though rest assured the items you ordered have low VOC levels. If you'd like to start the return process, please let our Customer support team know, and note that a restocking fee will apply, while original shipping fees are non-refundable.

Lulu and Georgia
